Це = емоційний proof of concept продукту. 3) 'Unboxing' ритуал друкованого плану робить intangible digital product ВІДЧУТНИМ — знижує бар'єр покупки. 4) Відсутність обличчя + лише руки жінки 60+ = universal identification без порівняння зовнішності.

top_hooks.text: [Visual]: Extreme close-up of two hands lifting a simple brown kraft mailer envelope from a doorstep. The hands are a woman's — natural nails, a thin silver ring. She turns it over slowly. No text on screen. [Audio]: The crisp sound of the paper envelope against her fingertips. Morning birdsong in the background. Complete silence — no music, no voiceover. The tactile sound of the envelope is the entire hook.

[Visual]: A kitchen table. A pair of reading glasses is set down with a soft click. Then two hands enter frame and begin slowly tearing open a kraft envelope — the ripping sound is satisfyingly clean and amplified. A folded printed plan slides out. [Audio]: Pure ASMR — the tear of paper, the whisper of the plan unfolding, a faint exhale of anticipation. Zero words. Zero music.

[Visual]: Bird's-eye shot of a clean wooden table. A sealed envelope sits in the center. A woman's hand enters frame holding a butter knife, slides it under the flap, and opens the envelope with one smooth motion. Inside: a neatly printed Tai Chi daily plan. [Audio]: The slice of the knife through paper — crisp and close-mic'd. A soft satisfied hum from off-camera. No voice. No text.

top_body_texts.text: [Scene: hands unfold the printed plan on a kitchen table — ASMR paper crinkling, close-up of fingers smoothing the creases] No voiceover for 8 seconds — just the sound of paper and breath. [Scene: a green highlighter uncaps with a soft pop, the woman circles Day 1] Then a gentle female voiceover begins: This is your plan. / Not an app. Not a screen. Something you hold. / Something you mark up with your own hands. [Scene: she places a small fridge magnet over the plan on the refrigerator — the click of magnet on metal] Seven days of gentle Tai Chi. Printed. Mailed to you. Free. / Because sometimes healing starts / with something you can touch. [Text appears on screen over the magnet shot] Get yours free. Link below.

[Scene: ASMR sequence continues — fingers trace the printed movements on the page, tapping each illustration gently, the paper texture audible] 10 seconds of pure sensory footage, no voice. [Scene: she sets a ceramic mug of tea beside the plan — the soft clink of cup on wood] Voiceover fades in softly: No download. No login. No password you'll forget. / Just a plan that arrives at your door / like a letter from someone who gets it. [Scene: her finger underlines a printed line that reads 'Day 1: Breathe and Begin'] You don't need motivation. You need a first step small enough to take. / This is that step. [Soft text on screen] Free printed plan — delivered to your mailbox.

[Scene: the woman pins the printed plan to a cork board beside family photos — the push-pin sound is close-mic'd and satisfying] Still no speaking. She steps back. The camera slowly pulls out to reveal the plan hanging among personal mementos — a child's drawing, a birthday card, a vacation photo. [Voiceover begins, warm and unhurried]: It belongs here. / Not in your phone, buried under notifications. / Right here — where you'll see it every morning. / Ten minutes of Tai Chi. Day by day. / Your body already knows how to do this. / The plan just reminds you. [Scene: final shot — her hand gently touches the pinned plan] Get your free printed plan today. It's already waiting.

hypotheses.visual_prompt: Cinematic ASMR-style short-form video: begins with an extreme close-up of a kraft paper envelope being lifted from a sunlit doorstep by a woman's hands (age 50s, warm skin tone, minimal jewelry — one thin silver band), camera follows at macro distance as she carries it to a bright, clean kitchen with white oak surfaces and natural light streaming through a window; the entire first 15 seconds are shot as a sensory unboxing ritual — tearing the envelope (amplified paper sounds), unfolding a beautifully printed Tai Chi daily plan on cream stock, uncapping a green highlighter with an audible pop, circling 'Day 1', placing the plan on the refrigerator with a round ceramic magnet (satisfying click); camera uses slow macro push-ins, overhead flat angles, and gentle dolly slides; color grade is warm and bright with soft natural whites and sage green accents; sound design is pure ASMR — paper textures, breathing, small tactile sounds, complete silence for the first 10-15 seconds before a minimal warm ambient tone fades in underneath; no music with beats, no voiceover until mid-video; the mood is ritualistic, calming, and deeply tactile, evoking the feeling of receiving a personal letter
